query:
WITH list_view AS (
        SELECT
            pb.id as id,
            al.name as ao,
            pb.channel_id,
            pb.title,
            string_to_array(lower(qs), ',') as qs,
            date,
            pb.start_time,
            pb.why,
            string_to_array(COALESCE(pb.equipment, ''), ',') as equipment,
            pb.fng_message,
            pb.mole_skin,
            string_to_array(COALESCE(pb.img_ids, ''), ',') as img_ids,
            pb.ts,
            pb.location_url
        FROM pre_blasts pb
        INNER JOIN ao_list al on pb.channel_id = al.channel_id
    )

    SELECT
        id,
        ao,
        channel_id,
        title,
        qs as "qs!",
        date,
        start_time,
        why,
        equipment as "equipment!",
        fng_message,
        mole_skin,
        img_ids as "img_ids!",
        ts,
        location_url
    FROM list_view
    WHERE id = $1
    ORDER BY date DESC;
